I got out last night in the baby cat and assessed the state of the trails. McKay Loop is Groomed and track set, but only from the Summit Access down to the Cattle Grid, the northeast side is clear of snow from about halfway up. Pretty Valley Road from Eagle Rock to the Stockyards is groomed and track set, it held up fairly well with just a few thin spots and some patchy spots as you get close to the Stockyards. Pretty Valley Road from Eagle Rock down to Panorama Loop is very patchy and ungroomed. Panorama Loop is partially groomed and track set, from AGL corner to just before the Observation Deck. High Plains Road is fairly poor, from the Aqueduct to the turn off for AGL corner. Lower Horseyard Loop is groomed and set from the Nordic Bowl to the Aqueduct. Aqueduct from High Plains Road is groomed for about 100 mtrs into the Nordic Bowl. The Nordic Bowl is Partially groomed and track set. It was a foggy and damp night, the snow did try and set up very briefly, but when I finished at about 6am it was still very damp. There is definitely a few KMs to ski! The track setting is a bit average as I had to keep lifting the tiller to repair damage to the trails. Have a great day!
